name: PDB2PQR
summary: Protein preparation and charge/radius assignment for electrostatics calculations.

steps: Read the current PDB2PQR maintainer documentation and select the documented PyPI or source route for the user's operating system.
Review the Python and dependency requirements, then install into a new virtual environment; avoid the optional web service when the user requires local-only processing.
Check the installed CLI help before preparing any experimental structure, and review the selected force field and protonation assumptions separately.
install.verify_note: Run the documented CLI help in the isolated environment. A small prepared-structure example is a separate scientific check.

notes: The local installer must not upload structures to the public PDB2PQR/APBS web server. Protonation and force-field choices are scientific decisions.
